lines.text: Flies ruin Egypt, and Moses refuses to sacrifice in the land, saying they must go three days into the wilderness.
Pharaoh says not to go very far, Moses prays, the LORD removes the flies, but Pharaoh hardens his heart.
The LORD sends a plague on Egypt's livestock, including horses, donkeys, sheep, and herds, but none of Israel's animals die.
Moses tosses soot into the air, boils break out on man and beast, and the priests cannot stand before Moses.
